PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: All of Beatrix's squares are in row 4, so nobody else can use it. All of Douglas's squares are in row 3, so nobody else can use it. So Angus (A) must be at row 2, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: With the rows and columns of Angus crossed out, only one square is left for Beatrix that fits her clue ("She was beside some flowers."). So Beatrix (B) must be at row 4, column 2. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Look at Eleanor: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 5, column 1. So nobody else can stand at row 5, column 1, or Eleanor would have nowhere to go. Eleanor's clue ("Someone else in her area was beside a tree.") needs the person beside a tree in Eleanor's area on a square that does not share her row or column; that rules out squares for Eleanor. All of Carmen's squares are in column 5, so nobody else can use it. So Eleanor (E) must be at row 5, column 4. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Douglas that fits his clue ("He was in the Parking Area or the Meadow."). So Douglas (D) must be at row 3, column 6. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Who can be the person beside a tree in Eleanor's area? Only Valentine, because nobody else can still reach a square that fits Eleanor's clue ("Someone else in her area was beside a tree."). That rules out Valentine's other squares. So Valentine (the victim) must be at row 6, column 1. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Carmen that fits her clue ("She was exactly two columns east of Angus."). So Carmen (C) must be at row 1, column 5. Cross out her row and column. Eleanor is the only person in the Woods with Valentine, so Eleanor is the murderer!

CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_0: He was the only person standing in a puddle.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_2: She was exactly two columns east of Angus.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_3: He was in the Parking Area or the Meadow.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_4: Someone else in her area was beside a tree. She was in the Woods, but not beside a shrub.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_5: The Victim. He was alone with the murderer.
